verdict: Spend is producing sales at a strong return, but the lead engine has nearly stalled this period.
diagnosis: $7,220 in spend drove just 2 leads and 9 purchases worth $5,897 — purchases are carrying the account, not lead flow.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $7,220 spend
signals.detail: Cost per lead landed at roughly $3,610 this period. Far above any healthcare benchmark we can find.

signals.headline: 9 purchases returned $5,897 in revenue
signals.detail: Return on ad spend sits near 0.8x on purchases alone. Below breakeven before product and fulfillment costs.

signals.headline: Main call campaign is paused
signals.detail: The Search Calls campaign shows paused status. Phone leads are the natural fit for a medical alert buyer.

signals.headline: 196 direction requests, 1 call click
signals.detail: Local profile drove foot-traffic intent but almost no phone action. Mismatch for a nationwide alert device.

signals.headline: 4,652 clicks, 139 landing page views
signals.detail: Only 3% of clicks reached the landing page. Suggests tracking gaps or a slow, broken page experience.

recommendations.title: Reactivate the paused Search Calls campaign
recommendations.detail: Phone is the natural channel for this buyer. Consider restarting with a tight keyword list around 'medical alert' and 'life alert' before Q4 intent fades.

recommendations.title: Audit the landing page and conversion tracking
recommendations.detail: Only 139 of 4,652 clicks registered as page views. Worth checking page load, mobile layout, and whether the lead pixel is firing correctly.

recommendations.title: Test an adult-child creative angle
recommendations.detail: Research shows adult children drive most purchases. Consider testing ad copy aimed at sons and daughters shopping for aging parents, not seniors themselves.
